notes.title: 7.9.2015 Maintenance Update
notes.content:
We released a small maintenance release today. 

The STEAM Plugin Manager has been updated to our latest version.

It has also been moved from:

"[STEAMLibrary]\common\Cakewalk\STEAM Plugin Manger"

to

"[STEAMLibrary]\common\Cakewalk\Misc\STEAM Plugin Manger"

Both of these fixes were due to changes in [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/352290]Rapture Pro.[/url]
